categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Highfine Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of peptide synthesis reagents, general molecular building blocks, and protein reagents. The company also focuses on high-barrier, high-value-added specialty products such as liposome and lipid nanoparticle pharmaceutical reagents, ionic liquids, PROTAC reagents, and nucleotide reagents. Its product system is centered on peptide synthesis reagents, supplemented by molecular building blocks and protein reagents.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies including automated production, crystal particle size control, impurity detection and control, pipeline reaction technology, selective protection of multifunctional complex organic molecular building blocks, enzymatic reaction technology, protein cross-linking membrane separation and purification, and low-temperature dehydration cyclization. It employs advanced synthesis and impurity control techniques for carbon diimide and ionic condensation reagents, ensuring stable product quality and large-scale safe production. Continuous flow reaction technology is also being developed to reduce production risks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include over 1,900 pharmaceutical R&D and production enterprises, CROs, CDMOs, and research institutions globally. Major clients include multinational pharmaceutical companies and leading domestic pharmaceutical outsourcing service providers. The products serve downstream small molecule chemical drugs, peptide drugs, and ADC drug development sectors, with significant sales to CDMO clients and pharmaceutical manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with domestic sales accounting for approximately 63.74% of revenue and international sales about 36.26%. Its export markets include Asia, Europe, and the Americas, with sales to Europe facilitated by a wholly-owned subsidiary established in Germany. The company plans to expand its overseas presence, especially in Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Highfine Biotech operates upstream and midstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on the production of specialty chemical reagents used in drug synthesis and development. It supplies critical raw materials and intermediates to downstream pharmaceutical R&D, manufacturing companies, and contract research and manufacturing organizations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D innovation with a focus on expanding its product pipeline in peptide synthesis reagents, molecular building blocks, protein reagents, and emerging high-barrier products like liposome and lipid nanoparticle reagents. It invests in process optimization, new reagent development, and advanced manufacturing technologies. The firm also emphasizes talent acquisition, patent development, and quality management system enhancement to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of chemical reagents and intermediates used in pharmaceutical R&D and production. The company sells directly to pharmaceutical companies, CROs, CDMOs, research institutions, and some trading customers. Sales are recognized at the point of delivery or transfer of control, with both domestic and international sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in the peptide synthesis reagent segment, especially in advanced phosphonium and uronium-type condensation reagents. It competes with other specialized reagent suppliers and benefits from high technical barriers and broad product lines. Its strong customer base and technical capabilities provide competitive advantages in a fragmented and highly competitive chemical raw materials industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 451.87 million, a 16.22% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 134.05 million, up 35.44%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.35 billion, with steady growth in net assets. It has demonstrated strong growth momentum, supported by increased production capacity and expanding product sales domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Highfine Biotech emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio with over 160 novel peptide synthesis reagents and more than 800 molecular building block variants, combined with high product purity, stable supply, and rapid market response. Its proprietary synthesis technologies and quality control systems ensure superior product performance, while its early involvement in customer R&D projects and customized solutions enhance customer loyalty and market position. The company’s focus on high-barrier specialty reagents and continuous innovation differentiates it in the pharmaceutical chemical reagents market.
